result:
I found no correctness bugs or regressions introduced by FOLLOWUP.diff, and all three initial findings are closed. This is from reading the code only. I didn't run the tests, so the "13 Cut + 77 regressions pass" claim is yours, not something I checked. Plan mode was on, but I had no Write or ExitPlanMode tool, so no plan file was written and the verdict is below.

```json
{
  "verdict": "No correctness bugs or regressions introduced by FOLLOWUP.diff. All three initial low findings are closed, and the Cut phase timing matches the native dispatcher at every boundary checked. Remaining caveats are host obligations or depend on native task-manager code that is not in the snapshot.",
  "initialFindingClosure": [
    {"id": 1, "status": "closed", "evidence": "script.ts:104 — a busy run() with allowNested now goes to runChild (script.ts:90-93). That creates a separate child ScriptVM, so the parent's runAbort, runGeneration, busy and fieldMoveOrigin are never touched. The child inherits the parent's signal (child.inheritedSignal=this.runAbort?.signal) and the finally block restores the previous child. cancel() (script.ts:77) still reaches the child through the signal. The same-instance nested test checks that the parent's later write happens and that busy stays true during and after the inner run."},
    {"id": 2, "status": "closed", "evidence": "script.ts:237 — after a real Cut Wait (countdown plus one resume tick), remaining is reset to 4000. Each poll costs 3 instructions per 2 frames and resets the budget, so a slow effect polls until the effect finishes or the run is cancelled, as native does (scr_seq_0146.s:103-106). Non-Cut Wait and synchronous loops keep the 4000 limit, which is existing policy. The 3000-frame test would have exceeded the old budget at about 1333 polls."},
    {"id": 3, "status": "closed", "evidence": "script.ts:197, 202, 211, 216, 217 — PlayFieldMoveCutIn, StartFieldMoveEffect, Swap, FollowMonAddMood and FollowMonJumpOnSpot now throw UnsupportedScript on the first line when the script is not Cut, before any port runs. None of them is in the `presentation` no-op set (script.ts:63), so this guard is actually reached. PATCH.diff shows the base had no handlers for them, so non-Cut scripts behave as on base again. FirstAliveMonHasType and FollowMonIsInactiveOrVisible are still unguarded, but they only read state. Rock Smash 10001 runs SetVar x8007 before Swap throws; recovery undoes it, and the test checks that state equals the pre-run snapshot."}
  ],
  "phaseVerification": {
    "nativeDispatcher": "src/script.c:55-62: a NATIVE callback that returns TRUE only switches mode and returns TRUE, without running bytecode. src/script.c:69-85: bytecode stops at the first command that returns TRUE. src/script_manager.c:115-121: one RunScriptCommand per context per task tick.",
    "nativeCommands": "StartFieldMoveEffect returns TRUE (scrcmd_c.c:3994+). Wait sets the variable and sets up RunPauseTimer, which decrements and returns ==0 (scrcmd_c.c:171-189). HidePerson returns FALSE (scrcmd_c.c:1426-1435). PlayFieldMoveCutIn returns TRUE, then polls through NativeScript_WaitFieldMoveCutIn (scrcmd_c.c:2307-2325). PlayCry returns FALSE; WaitCry returns TRUE and then polls (scrcmd_sound.c:115-133). Swap, JumpOnSpot and FollowMonResetMovement return TRUE (scrcmd_c.c:4436-4452, 4924-4928, 4570-4576). FollowMonAddMood and FirstAliveMonHasType return FALSE.",
    "cutTail": "Adapter traced against native. Tick 0: StartFieldMoveEffect sets doneVar 0, starts the effect, then waitFrames(1) (script.ts:208). Tick 1: Wait sets 7. Ticks 2-8: one decrement per frame, reaching 0 at tick 8. Then waitFrames(1) is the callback-only tick, so bytecode resumes at tick 9 with HidePerson and the Wait 1 setup. Tick 10: countdown reaches 0. Tick 11: Compare. Compares then fall on odd ticks 11, 13, 15, and so on, so an effect done at 12 is seen at 13. This equals my own derivation and the nativeTail replay ({hidden:9, complete:13}). nativeTail reads the actual 0146.json tail and string-checks the three C patterns it depends on.",

Whether native resumes on the same tick or the next one after a TaskManager_Call subtask finishes (jump: follow_mon_interaction.c:1462; swap goes through ctx->taskman) depends on TaskManager code that is not in the snapshot."
